# Seed Supplier Contact Details

The supplier ships within two days from March through June and pauses over
midsummer, so late orders wait until August.

## Observations

- [fact] Orders placed after 15 June ship in August #suppliers
- [convention] Re-check the catalogue before the spring order goes in #suppliers
